snippet.title: Rusty Winter | Official Reveal Trailer | Steam PC
snippet.description:
Rusty Winter is an adventure game inspired by hardboiled detective stories.

Meet a diverse cast, chase down leads that blur the boundaries between reality and the paranormal, and explore a cold, once-glorious industrial town in search of your missing loved one.

Wishlist NOW:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290380/Rusty_Winter/
